statements.query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.created_at AS "createdAt",
       coalesce((
         SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
           $2, p.id, $3, p.title, $4, p.body,
           $5, p.created_at,
           $6, coalesce((
             SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
               $7, c.id, $8, c.author, $9, c.body,
               $10, c.created_at) ORDER BY c.id)
             FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id), $11)
         ) ORDER BY p.id)
         FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = u.id), $12) AS posts
     FROM users u WHERE u.id = $1
